ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70 percent low-intensity black pixels in central regions versus 30 percent high-intensity white pixels localized on distal lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral 25 percent of each lobe; central 75 percent is dominated by a solid low-intensity black mass with minor internal grayscale mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle of approximately 35 degrees relative to the fluke mid-plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 2 to 12 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep transitioning to an aggressive upward taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, dark circular spots localized within the high-intensity white region of the right distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark surface of the left lobe, approximately 45 degrees relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy, irregular dark-textured masses or growths present on the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes, disrupting the clean geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and turbulence partially occlude the lower leading edges of both fluke lobes.
